ns2:section.sectionText: This lab will be split between 124, 218 and 220 Kiln House. Subjects covered in lab: PLGA microsphere formulation; controlled release drug delivery; collagen extraction and purification from bovine skin; collagen sponge scaffold fabrication and characterization; hydroxyapatite/fluorapatite scaffold fabrication and characterization. Desired background: chemistry/biochemistry.
